statements.status_notes: Debian brotli 1.1.0-2+deb13u1 includes the fix described by GHSA-9V8H-QQGM-4M35. The python3-brotli extension is compiled from the same patched source, including c/dec/decode.c. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35

Debian brotli 1.1.0-2+deb13u1 includes the fix for CVE-2026-111497. The python3-brotli extension is compiled from the same patched source, including c/dec/decode.c. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-111497

DHI rebuild backports upstream brotli commits 28ce91caf605ac5481e9ca69131a28e1087574b7 and eb3a31e2d356d5a633de995afe7fe60e590a26d8, adding the Python streaming-decompression output-limiting support released in 1.2.0. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-6176
